更新舒适，更新所有节点，这在最新的级联更新上运行。

此工作流程的模型可以从 Huggingface 下载：https://huggingface.co/stabilityai/stable-cascade/tree/main/comfyui_checkpoints，或者在管理器中。它们像所有其他检查点模型一样进入您的正常检查点文件夹中。

这与裸版本不兼容，它构建在 2 个模型上，与阶段 C 中的剪辑和阶段 B 中的 VAE 轻松合并。基础运行在 8gb 上，但工作流程正在 12gb 卡上开发。我们会看看它降落在哪里。 （目前 LLM 略多于 10GB）

~

这是一个超早期的 alpha 视觉比较和重采样工作流程，以实现稳定的级联。它不整洁或功能丰富哈哈。当我有时间的时候，这个会经常更新。

Update comfy, update all your nodes, this runs on the newest update for cascade.

The models for this workflow can be downloaded from huggingface athttps://huggingface.co/stabilityai/stable-cascade/tree/main/comfyui_checkpoints, Or in the manager. They go in your normal checkpoints folder like all other checkpoint models.

This is not compatible with the bare builds, it is built on the 2 model comfy merge with clip in stage C and VAE in stage B. The base runs on 8gb, but the workflow is being developed on a 12gb card. We'll see where it lands. (currently a little over 10GB with LLM's)

~

This is a super early alpha visual compare and resample workflow for stable cascade. It is not tidy or feature packed lol. This will be updated frequently as I have time.

~

KJNodes needs to be installed currently

~

Qwen:https://huggingface.co/hahahafofo/Qwen-1_8B-Stable-Diffusion-Prompt-GGUF/tree/main

Llava:https://huggingface.co/jartine/llava-v1.5-7B-GGUF/tree/bb0fd6769f034ecd20d36d060d3dfd1b661d7c3c
